info.headline: Penglai District Meteorological Observatory issues a red warning signal for high temperatures [Level I/Particularly Severe]
info.description: At 13:31 on August 1, 2026, the Penglai District Meteorological Observatory upgraded the high temperature orange warning signal to a high temperature red warning signal: Currently, the highest temperature in villages and towns in our district has exceeded 39 ℃. It is expected that all towns and streets in our district will still experience high temperatures of 36-38 ℃ and locally above 40 ℃ from this afternoon to tomorrow. The temperature is high, the humidity is high, and I feel stuffy and hot. Please pay attention to preventing the adverse effects of sustained high temperatures on agricultural production, human health, outdoor work, and urban life.

info.headline: 蓬莱区气象台变更发布高温红色预警信号[Ⅰ级/特别严重]
info.description: 蓬莱区气象台2026年08月01日13时31分将高温橙色预警信号升级为高温红色预警信号：目前，我区村里集镇最高气温已超过39℃，预计今天下午到明天我区全部镇街仍将出现36～38℃、局部40℃以上的高温天气。气温高，湿度大，体感闷热。请注意防范持续高温对农业生产、人体健康、户外作业和城市生活的不利影响。
